title: Bayit+ review
selecting: Select a page element. Use Tab then Enter, or click. Escape cancels.
keyboard: Arrow keys also move between page elements while selecting.
empty: Select an element to record a finding or explicit verification.
privacy: No page text, form values, query strings, or raw element identifiers are captured. Keep secrets out of your comments.
orphan: Orphaned: target unavailable. Reattach to confirm its identity.
offscreen: Target is outside the visible viewport.
reattached: Pin reattached to the selected element.
storageFailure: Local storage is unavailable or full. Changes remain in memory; export before leaving.
invalidStorage: Saved evidence could not be read. It has been preserved; export this session before leaving.
exportFailure: Export failed. Your in-memory evidence is still available.
invalidFinding: Complete every field. Verified findings need explicit no-code verification; resolved findings need remediation.
limit: The evidence limit has been reached. Export existing pins before starting a new review.
selectionFailure: This element cannot be anchored. Select another visible page element.
missingBuild: Review evidence is unavailable because this build has no exact commit SHA.
loadFailure: Review mode could not load. Reload this page to retry.
